Zarki Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Żarki, Poland

Demolished. A single tombstone fragment, dated 1739 and bearing a partial epitaph, was discovered in a local property in 2008 and identified as originating from Żarki's old Jewish cemetery, established in the 17th century; thanks to preservationist Wojciech Mszyca, it was placed at the site and, in 2010, incorporated into a proper lapidarium unveiled that September. This record's gravestone-count field reads '1739' — almost certainly the tombstone's date rather than an actual count, matching a pattern of similar year-for-count mix-ups flagged elsewhere in this collection.
